The '''petite raider'''<ref name="audio description">{{FOTV|1|1}} audio description</ref> is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
===Post-War===
The petite wastelander was one of [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]'s [[Vault 32 raider|raiders]], during their invasion and occupation of [[Vault 32]]. 

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
At [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] and [[Monty (TV series)|Monty]]'s wedding reception, she sat at [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]]'s table right next to [[Steph Harper|Steph]]. The petite raider stole a piece of food from Steph's plate and then listened to [[Hank MacLean|Hank's]] speech.

Afterward, she's seen not wearing the top of her [[Vault jumpsuit (TV series)|Vault 32 jumpsuit]] and now wielding a pair of [[Knife (TV series)|Knives]]. The petite raider uses them to kill some of the [[Vault 33 dweller]]s, and she tries to attack [[Norm MacLean|Norm]] but is shot in the eye by Lucy's [[Tranq gun (TV series)|Tranq gun]].

===[[The Head]]===
The raider is seen eating a tray of food served to her by [[Marianne (TV series)|Marianne]].

'''Nurse Powell''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Sometime in his life, Powell became a nurse and was assigned to work with [[Nose Edmundson|Dr. Nose Edmundson]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Nurse Powell stands by as Dr. Edmundson extracts a tooth out of [[Maximus]]' left arm and is told by the doctor that he'll need an antibiotic. Once the doctor was finished treating Maximus, he followed him away.

Afterward, Nurse Powell would be seen eating at a picnic table and later again while a [[Vault 4 dweller]] heads to the center of the Vault. Nurse Powell informs [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] about the Surface Dweller tradition, which, in his opinion, is too rambunctious for him, and walks away.

==Personality==
Not much is known about Nurse Powell's personality; however, in his opinion, the Surface Dweller tradition is a little rambunctious for his taste.

==Notable quotes==
* {{Inline quote|It's a Surface Dweller tradition. It can get a little rambunctious for my taste.|Talking to Lucy about where the Vault 4 Dwellers are heading}}

==Appearances==
Nurse Powell appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
